answer: In PoA, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks on an attestation graph: each step follows a verified edge, while accumulated visit mass determines voting weight. A Sybil coalition forms a low-conductance set when few honest attestations cross its external cut; conductance and min-cut transitivity bounds then cap its reachable mass and aggregate vote. Even if its pigment, plume, or nadir shifts locally, limited leakage constrains influence.
